source: SimCSE uses this form with cosine similarity and in-batch negatives. Its unsupervised version produces two representations of the same sentence using independent dropout masks; its supervised version uses entailment pairs as positives and contradiction examples as hard negatives. [11]
zh: SimCSE 使用这种具有余弦相似性和批内负数的形式。它的无监督版本使用独立的 dropout mask 生成同一个句子的两种表示；它的监督版本使用蕴涵对作为正例，使用矛盾示例作为硬负例。 [11]
